decision.observation: 8:50 am; the south-west move barely moved the farmer—a fallen log and bushes block; the pond is still not visible in this view.
decision.hypothesis: Bushes and fence at the right block south-east; the pond lies south-west beyond the bush thicket. Going west then south along the left side may reach the water.
decision.memory: Pond has a stump east bank; north rim casting spots. Rod = slot 6; hold C ~0.9s, press C only on a clear bite. Ship via bin before 2 am; bed restored indoors.
